programme.title: Abu Ubaidah Bin Al Jarrah
programme.desc: The story follows Abu Ubaidah Ibn Al Jarrah, an early convert to Islam and one of the ten promised Paradise, known as the Prophet Muhammad’s “Trustee of the Nation.” It traces his role in the Prophet’s campaigns, his leadership under Abu Bakr and Omar, and his command of Muslim armies during the conquest of the Levant, ending with his death during the Plague of Amwas.

programme.title: Al Laaebon Bel Nar
programme.desc: The work follows Tawfik, who is in love with Laila, but problems surround them and lead to conflicts between them. Meanwhile, his old friend, Naguib, and his sister, Nadia, return, but Tawfik's sister, Nawara, insists that Naguib is a thief, though no one believes her. The conflict between ambition, love, and betrayal intensifies as the events become increasingly intertwined.
